call_templates.label: Overnight Night-Audit Courtesy Call-Around (11:30 PM - 4:00 AM)
call_templates.opening_script: Hi Front Desk, good evening! Calling from the night-audit desk down the street doing our nightly courtesy occupancy call-around. We're sitting at {my_occ}% with {my_left} rooms left tonight at ${my_bar} — how is your occupancy looking tonight, how many rooms do you have left, and what's your walk-in rate?
call_templates.followup_question: Awesome, thank you! And are you holding your rate floor for this weekend or pushing BAR up?

call_templates.label: Quick Reservation / Walk-In Availability Check (Any Shift)
call_templates.opening_script: Hi Front Desk! Quick question — if we have overflow walk-in guests tonight, do you still have standard king or double rooms open, about how many rooms do you have left, and what rate are you quoting at the desk?
call_templates.followup_question: Got it, and does that rate include your resort fee or is that plus fee and tax?

call_templates.label: Weekend Compression & Group Block Check
call_templates.opening_script: Hi Reservations! Checking if you still have 5+ rooms open for this coming weekend or if you're already over 85% committed, and what your current Best Available Rate is?
call_templates.followup_question: Thanks so much — I'll note your rate on our desk sheet!
